scope: LaTeX notation and build-time typesetting for the English enming group reference library

implementation.rendering: Build-time HTML plus accessible MathML with TeX annotations; self-hosted CSS and fonts; no runtime math library or CDN
implementation.sourceConvention: Raw LaTeX in section.formula; explicit \(...\) or \[...\] delimiters in article prose; doubled backslashes in JSON
implementation.parser: Explicit delimiters only. Strict parsing fails on invalid TeX or mismatched delimiters. Plain prose and code remain HTML-escaped.
implementation.overflow: Width-constrained scroll containers preserve long equations. Progressive enhancement names and focuses a scroll container only when its content overflows; checks repeat after resize, fonts, and details changes.

preservation.comparison: All 174 articles compared programmatically with baseline: titles, summaries, IDs, prerequisites, section IDs/titles, code, references/notes, ordering, and content-field counts unchanged.
preservation.semanticReview: Each conversion range reviewed its notation. Independent review of all 36 display formulas in 05-08 and high-risk ELBO, KL, CFG, PPO, and DPO expressions in 09-12 found no mathematical-equivalence defects.
preservation.residualScan: All 12 modules scanned outside explicit math delimiters. One missed guidance-weight variable in 09-14 was corrected. Remaining API/code strings and model names are intentionally plain text.

validation.strictMathParsing: 101 display formulas and 1406 inline expressions passed with strict:error and throwOnError:true
validation.renderingChecks: Fractions, indices/exponents, matrices, escaped prose, accessible MathML, malformed delimiter rejection, invalid TeX rejection, and self-hosted font paths verified.
validation.interactionChecks: DOM adapter verified overflow becoming/ceasing keyboard-focusable, hidden expressions, fonts/details changes, and resize fallback. Supplied test dimensions are not browser layout measurements.
validation.localHttp: Five representative article routes (01-01, 04-03, 06-03, 09-04, 12-13), KaTeX CSS, and a WOFF2 font returned HTTP 200; article responses contain rendered MathML.
validation.browserVisualQA: Not completed. Native Computer Use stopped because it could not determine the current browser URL confidently enough to enforce policy. No browser automation continued after that stop.

independentReviewResolution.finding: Overflowing inline formulas lacked consistent keyboard scroll access.
independentReviewResolution.fix: Conditional tabindex, named region, visible focus, and layout/font/details refreshes added to the existing article script.
independentReviewResolution.test: Overflow state-transition tests passed without adding unnecessary tab stops or moving focus.

limitations: This conversion preserves the reviewed scientific content but is not a new scientific review or a new Claude review. review/content-audit.json remains the historical record of the prior Claude Code passes.
Desktop/mobile screenshots, real-browser layout, and screen-reader behavior were not verified in this pass. Static HTML/CSS checks and simulated DOM dimensions do not establish visual correctness.
